verdict.rationale: Sprinto has a first-party doc page titled "Perform Access Review for a Critical System" and a related "Monitor Access Checks" page under its Access data library, so access reviews are a documented in-product capability. Integrations such as FreeAgent map user access to connected systems, and the platform claims general evidence collection. However, the evidence is essentially page titles, with no detail on how reviews run, how reviewers sign off, or where results are stored. missing for 10: periodic/scheduled review campaigns, coverage across all connected apps, in-app reviewer sign-off workflow, the review artifact landing automatically in the evidence library, independent or hands-on corroboration.
